segments.text:
IN the thyrd yeare of the reigne of Iehoiakim kyng of Iuda came Nebuchadnezer kyng of Babel vnto Ieruſalē
and beſieged it.

2 And the Lord gaue Iehoiakim the kyng into hys hand with part of the veſſels of the houſe of GOD which he caried into the land of Shinar to the houſe of his God, and brought thē into his Gods treaſurie.
3 And the kyng ſpake vnto Aſhpenaz the maſter of his Eunuches, that he ſhould bryng certaine of the children of Iſrael of the kynges ſeede and of the Princes
4 Children in whom there was no blemiſh. &c.
